statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted were I25.10 and I34.0
The denial reason code was CO-197
The patient has recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The monitoring was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The monitoring was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
